name: The Lost Pages
label: Quest

intro: While transporting a newly acquired goblin shredder from Ratchet to the Warsong Lumber Camp, the orc Gurda Ragescar lost the machine's operating manual to a sudden gust of wind. Stranded near Splintertree Post, she cannot run the complex engineering marvel without recovering the scattered pages.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.
The pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... But I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: I hope you find the pages soon, friend! I really need to get back to work!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Reading isn't my strong point... But now I'll be able to get back to work! Thanks, friend!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
